cand.title: SOL Punta Cana 2027
cand.excerpt: SOL page states dates, four-day program, international crowd and accommodation options.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Dylan Opara is the strongest contact: current co-founder whose profile explicitly covers event operations, budgets, logistics and partnerships. Daniel Olanegan identifies as Founder at We Outside Ltd with operations, strategy and business development; a company-register mirror also lists him as a director. Both are commercially relevant introductions, not verified hotel signatories. Dami Olaniyan is an additional historical founder contact, but the profile ends the role in February 2026; current SOL involvement must be checked.
findings.futureEdition: Verified activity dates: 20–23 May 2027, Punta Cana, Dominican Republic. Recommended travel/stay dates are 19–24 May 2027; these are not five event days. Organizer product and FAQ agree, and its October 2026 announcement identifies May 2027 as the next international SOL project. No verified 2028 edition found.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference: Wyndham Alltra could suit a guestroom-led all-inclusive subgroup or organizer/artist stay, rather than the full multi-venue festival. Its 620 rooms, beach/outdoor spaces and 380 m² meeting provision offer a leisure base and modest hospitality functions, not proof of festival production suitability. Its secluded Uvero Alto setting is a disadvantage against the organizer’s explicit Bávaro/Downtown/Los Corales/El Cortecito lodging advice. Transport feasibility, late returns, sound policies and price acceptance must be tested before proposing space or rooms.
findings.venueCommitments: The organizer sells Faranda single 1 Hotel + General Admission and Hotel + VIP packages for two people sharing, with five nights and breakfast, 19–24 May 2027. This is a specific commercial accommodation offering, not just a preferred-hotel mention; underlying allotment, exclusivity and executed contract are not published. It does not establish Faranda as the festival venue. Organizer FAQ describes multiple Punta Cana venues and says the full schedule/venues will be released to ticket holders. No exclusive host hotel established.
findings.historicalRotation: No verified SOL edition-by-edition rotation established. Related We Outside Malta editions demonstrate organizer experience, not proof that SOL rotates annually: Malta 2025, 12–16 June; Malta 2026 official product lists 11–15 June including a 15 June add-on. The 2026 product retrospectively reports over 2,500 guests at the 2025 debut. Do not transfer that attendance to SOL.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Three evidenced consumer pathways: self-booked accommodation; organizer referral to trusted travel partners with possible flight/hotel payment plans; and the specific Faranda hotel-plus-ticket packages. Travel partner names and hotel procurement decision-maker are unresolved. Consumer booking availability does not establish supplier sourcing is open. No public room block or hotel RFP found.
findings.organizationStructure: Commercial entertainment/events company, not an association. We Outside creates SOL; its FAQ markets WE OUTSIDE x SIX STARS. WE OUTSIDE LTD is a UK private limited company, number 15935598; the organizer publicly uses that corporate name. Six Stars is a collaborating brand, not a verified accommodation buyer, PCO or DMC. No appointed PCO/DMC or legal hotel contracting entity established.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Faranda already has an explicit SOL accommodation package, with breakfast rather than Alltra’s all-inclusive proposition. No sold-out inventory, overflow requirement, room-night total or unallocated block is evidenced. A separate similarly branded SOL site lists Probar Suites, Impress Resort and Spa and Hard Rock Hotel, names Pearl Beach Club and Imagine Nightclub, and markets 4,000 travelers; however its footer says May 20–23, 2026 and credits Outside Never Outside/Six Stars. Its linkage and edition are unresolved, so none is treated as a confirmed 2027 booking or attendance figure.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Dylan Opara via his professional profile, with Daniel Olanegan as a second operations/business-development route. Ask who contracts accommodation, whether Faranda is exclusive, current pickup and unplaced demand, and whether an additional all-inclusive hotel is commercially useful. Request final event locations and transport plan before offering a conditional 19–24 May 2027 subgroup rate. Check late-night arrivals, guest/non-guest access, minimum stays, meal usage and noise restrictions internally. Do not send a speculative festival buyout or claim an RFP. If 2027 lodging is locked or location unsuitable, request a post-event review; ORS retains qualification/publication authority.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the selected May 2027 edition, guests may independently select hotels, but Faranda is already sold as an organizer package. Therefore neither wholly committed elsewhere nor verified open sourcing is established. Alltra has no published booking commitment; approach only as a conditional additional accommodation option, not assumed overflow or host replacement.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: establish a relationship now for any additional 2027 lodging requirement and seek a post-event review for future programmes. No annual SOL recurrence or future destination/2028 dates verified, so future capture is a strategy rather than a forecast or confirmed cycle.
